operation.summary: Every call this phone made to a server off the device: destination, purpose, which agent caused it, the data categories sent, bytes, status, time, and a redacted preview of what was sent and received

query.name: destination
query.description: Text in the host or service name, e.g. met.no, jev, relay

query.name: agent
query.description: Comma list of agent names or ids; me; phone or owner for calls nobody's agent caused

query.name: category
query.description: Comma list of data categories, any of them, e.g. location_1km,image,install_id

query.name: q
query.description: Text in the purpose, path or sent preview

query.name: bodies
query.description: false leaves out the sent/received previews (default true)

operation.returns: entries[id, at, destination{host, service}, method, path, purpose, agent, agent_id, categories[], bytes_sent, bytes_received, status, ok, error, duration_ms, query, headers (secrets redacted), sent_sha256, sent{type, preview}, received{type, preview}], next_cursor, latest_id, recording{on, changed_at, changed_by, note}, scope{sees: own|all}, coverage{recorded[], not_recorded[]}

agent.description: Comma list of agent names or ids; me; phone or owner for calls nobody's agent caused

bodies.description: false leaves out the sent/received previews (default true)

destination.description: Text in the host or service name, e.g. met.no, jev, relay

q.description: Text in the purpose, path or sent preview

category.description: Comma list of data categories, any of them, e.g. location_1km,image,install_id
